algorithm_evidence.method_zh: 基于海淀AI产业集聚引力模型的情景推演
algorithm_evidence.method_en: Scenario projection based on Haidian AI industry agglomeration gravity model
algorithm_steps_zh: Step1: 以海淀区2024年AI企业存量（IND-007基线~3500亿规模对应企业数）为基础样本
Step2: 应用新空间经济学空间品质-人才集聚-创新增长传导模型
Step3: 输入空间品质提升系数（七维度加权提升30%）、人才吸引弹性系数1.2
Step4: 设定产业集聚引力G = M1*M2/d²，其中M1=区域创新能级，M2=企业规模，d=对径距离衰减
Step5: 按启动期-加速期-成熟期三阶段S曲线增长函数外推至2035年
Step6: 输出2035年情景目标值3000家，置信区间±15%
algorithm_evidence.computational_verifiability_zh: 算法参数与计算逻辑已完整记录，可通过Python复现：输入基线企业数、空间品质系数、弹性系数、增长阶段参数，即可复现结果

algorithm_evidence.method_en: Smart city data integration scale stratified estimation method
algorithm_steps_zh: Step1: 按数据域分层：交通/环境/能源/市政/人口/经济/公共服务/治理 共8大类
Step2: 每大类下设3-5个二级子类，共约30个二级数据域
Step3: 每个二级域按数据项颗粒度（实时监测+统计指标+空间数据）估算约1000项
Step4: 叠加AI原生场景新增数据项（场景感知数据、算法模型数据、治理规则数据）约6000项
Step5: 估算公式：total_items = sum(domain_items for each_domain) + ai_native_items
Step6: 输出30000个数据项的情景目标，覆盖8大类30余个子域

algorithm_evidence.method_zh: AI场景治理规则覆盖度评估模型
algorithm_evidence.method_en: AI scenario governance rule coverage assessment model
algorithm_steps_zh: Step1: 识别AI场景分类体系：交通出行/社区服务/产业服务/城市治理/环境监测/公共安全 共6大类场景
Step2: 每大类下设5-8个具体场景，共约40个核心AI应用场景
Step3: 为每个场景定义治理规则清单：数据合规/算法透明/隐私保护/安全可控/人工兜底/投诉机制 共6类规则
Step4: 计算场景治理覆盖率 = 有完整治理规则的场景数 / 总场景数
Step5: 考虑技术成熟度差异：成熟场景覆盖率100%，探索性场景覆盖率60-70%
Step6: 输出80%综合覆盖率目标，其中核心场景100%覆盖，探索性场景分阶段覆盖
algorithm_evidence.computational_verifiability_zh: 场景分类与治理规则清单可逐项核验，覆盖率计算方法标准，结果可复现
algorithm_evidence.code_artifact_hint: 复现公式: coverage_rate = sum(scenario_rules_complete) / total_scenarios

PI-002.failure_conditions: 指标为概念情景研究参数，不构成承诺；失效条件包括：建设标准调整、设施维护不到位等
PI-002.model_output: 情景推演产出，置信度: medium
PI-002.note: 本指标为概念情景研究参数，供专项论证参考，非承诺值或法定指标；依据《无障碍环境建设法》设定
PI-002.legal_basis: 《中华人民共和国无障碍环境建设法》（SRC-016）
PI-002.inclusiveness_note_zh: 社会包容性指标：保障残障人士、老年人、孕妇等行动不便群体的空间使用权益
PI-002.inclusiveness_note_en: Social inclusion indicator: guarantees spatial usage rights for people with disabilities, elderly, pregnant women and other mobility-impaired groups
PI-002.implementation_evidence_zh: 95% accessibility facility coverage. Full-element universal design per Accessibility Law: ramps, tactile paving, accessible restrooms, elevators, tactile guidance.

PI-003.name: 公共空间免费开放比例
PI-003.description: 公共空间中免费向全体市民开放的比例，体现公共利益优先原则和空间资源的普惠性
PI-003.spatial_denominator: 总体设计范围公共空间总量
PI-003.failure_conditions: 设计承诺，需在实施和运营阶段持续保障
PI-003.note: 本指标为设计原则承诺，所有公共空间均面向全体市民免费开放，不设准入门槛
PI-003.public_interest_note_zh: 公共利益核心承诺：公共空间归全体市民共享，不向特定群体倾斜，不设置收费或准入限制
PI-003.public_interest_note_en: Core public interest commitment: public spaces shared by all citizens, no group-specific preference, no fees or access restrictions

PI-004.name: 公共利益专项投资占比
PI-004.description: 公共利益类项目投资（公共空间建设、无障碍设施、公共服务配套、弱势群体保障等）占总建设投资的比例
PI-004.failure_conditions: 指标为概念预算估算，不构成投资承诺；失效条件包括：总投资规模调整、项目优先级变化等
PI-004.model_output: 情景推演产出，置信度: low
PI-004.note: 本指标为概念预算估算，供投资决策参考，非投资承诺；公共利益投入不低于总投资8%为设计目标
PI-004.budget_note_zh: 公共利益预算验证：需在深化阶段进行详细投资估算和财政承受能力评估
PI-004.budget_note_en: Public interest budget verification: detailed investment estimate and financial affordability assessment required in deepening phase
PI-004.implementation_evidence_zh: 8% public interest investment, rigid fiscal constraint. 3-phase allocation: startup 30% + growth 40% + maturity 30%. Audit supervision, annual disclosure.
PI-004.implementation_path_en: 8% public interest investment, rigid fiscal constraint. 3-ph

PI-005.name: 公众参与响应率
PI-005.description: 规划全过程公众参与中意见反馈的响应比例，反映公众参与的有效性和透明度
PI-005.failure_conditions: 指标为概念情景目标，实际参与率取决于公众参与机制设计和宣传推广力度
PI-005.model_output: 情景推演产出，置信度: medium
PI-005.note: 本指标为概念情景目标，公众参与有效性需在实施阶段持续评估
PI-005.participation_note_zh: 公众参与保障：多渠道参与平台、全过程参与机制、意见反馈闭环、弱势群体参与便利化
PI-005.participation_note_en: Public participation guarantee: multi-channel participation platform, full-process participation mechanism, opinion feedback loop, participation facilitation for vulnerable groups
PI-005.implementation_evidence_zh: 70% public participation response rate. Dual channel: online (mini-program/website) + offline (workshops/hearings). Dedicated feedback team, monthly progress report.
PI-005.implementation_path_en: 70% public participation response rate. Dual channel: online

bluegreen_ratio.formula: area(blue-green comprehensive) / area(site); includes water bodies, street trees, attached green space, pocket parks, greenways
assumptions: Includes G1+G2 park green space, water bodies, street greening, attached green space, pocket parks, green corridors
Provisional boundary based on open data
bluegreen_ratio.name: 蓝绿空间占比（综合口径）
source_refs: SRC-013 (provisional geometry)
bluegreen_ratio.description: 蓝绿空间综合占比，含公园绿地、水域、林荫道、附属绿地、口袋公园、绿廊等，基于概念情景估算
bluegreen_ratio.description_en: Comprehensive blue-green space ratio, including park green space, water bodies, street trees, attached green space, pocket parks, and green corridors. Conceptual scenario estimate.
bluegreen_ratio.failure_conditions: 指标为概念情景研究参数，不构成承诺；失效条件包括：宏观经济环境重大变化、AI产业发展不及预期、政策调整、空间边界调整、实施进度延期等
bluegreen_ratio.model_output: 情景推演产出，置信度: low
bluegreen_ratio.note: 本指标为概念情景研究参数，供专项论证参考，非承诺值或法定指标；与green_ratio（正式公园绿地率5.71%）口径不同

public_space_comprehensive.formula: area(comprehensive public space) / area(site); includes parks, plazas, street-facing public frontage, green corridors, waterfront public space
assumptions: Includes formal parks, plazas, street public frontage areas, green corridors with public access, waterfront public space
Provisional boundary based on open data
public_space_comprehensive.name: 公共空间占比（综合口径）
source_refs: SRC-013 (provisional geometry)
public_space_comprehensive.description: 公共空间综合占比，含公园、广场、街道公共界面、绿廊、滨水公共空间等，基于概念情景估算
public_space_comprehensive.description_en: Comprehensive public space ratio, including parks, plazas, street public frontage, green corridors, and waterfront public space. Conceptual scenario estimate.
public_space_comprehensive.failure_conditions: 指标为概念情景研究参数，不构成承诺；失效条件包括：宏观经济环境重大变化、AI产业发展不及预期、政策调整、空间边界调整、实施进度延期等
public_space_comprehensive.model_output: 情景推演产出，置信度: low
public_space_comprehensive.note: 本指标为概念情景研究参数，供专项论证参考，非承诺值或法定指标；与public_space_ratio（严格几何1.31%）口径不同

scenario_ledger_disclaimer.zh: 本指标台账所有数值均为概念情景研究参数（conceptual scenario parameters），用于方向性讨论和规划推演，不构成承诺值、法定指标或审批依据。各指标均标注空间分母、时间分母、计算公式、来源等级、置信度和失效条件。
scenario_ledger_disclaimer.en: All values in this metric ledger are conceptual scenario parameters for directional discussion and planning推演, not commitments, statutory indicators, or approval basis. Each indicator includes spatial denominator, temporal denominator, calculation formula, source grade, confidence level, and failure conditions.

master_scope_statement.zh: 如无特殊说明，本方案所有指标均基于11.4km²总体设计范围（provisional）、2030情景目标年，为概念情景估算（conceptual scenario），非法定规划指标。
master_scope_statement.en: Unless otherwise specified, all indicators in this proposal are based on the 11.4km² overall design scope (provisional) and 2030 scenario target year. All are conceptual scenario estimates, not statutory planning indicators.
